about: The one Freeweights license table. scripts/licenses.py loads it; build_catalog.py, make_manifest.py, classify.py, policy/license-allowlist.md and site/content/docs/licenses.md all read from it. Keys are license ids, matched without case. Run `python3 scripts/licenses.py --write-docs` after an edit; validate_spec.py fails while the docs are out of date.

permissive.label: Permissive
permissive.meaning: Listed with a signed manifest. No click-through.

custom.label: Custom (click-through)
custom.meaning: Listed after a person read the text once. The commands stay folded until you open them after reading the license.

non-commercial.label: Non-commercial (link only)
non-commercial.meaning: Listed with a link to the source. Freeweights never hosts a copy.

refused.label: Refused
refused.meaning: Not listed. The reason goes to the public refusal log.

licenseref-tencent-hunyuan-community.name: LicenseRef-Tencent-Hunyuan-Community
licenseref-tencent-hunyuan-community.note: The Territory excludes the European Union, the United Kingdom and South Korea, and a worldwide hub cannot limit who downloads. Link only.

licenseref-minimax-h3-community.name: LicenseRef-MiniMax-H3-Community
licenseref-minimax-h3-community.note: The grant excludes the United States. Distribution from a US host is outside the grant.

licenseref-minimax-h3-image-community.note: The grant excludes the United States. Distribution from a US host is outside the grant.
